header.running_head: Rasulullaah ﷺ is Particular about Dispatching the Army of Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA) even on his Deathbed, after which Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) also Gives the Same Importance to the Matter When he Becomes the Khalifah

blocks.text: decided to return. He appointed Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) as commander of the army with instructions that any of them was at liberty to return to Madinah as soon as the Murtaddeen returned to Islaam and paid their zakaah. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) then returned to Madinah. [^1]

Hadhrat Urwa (RA) narrates that when the pledge of allegiance was taken on the hand of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA), the Ansaar became united in the matter of Khilaafah about which they had differed. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) dispatched the army of Hadhrat Usaama (RA) and many Arab tribes renounced Islaam. While in some cases, complete tribes renounced Islaam, it was only individuals in other tribes who renounced Islaam. Hypocrisy started to surface and Judaism and Christianity began raising their heads. Because they had just lost their Nabi ﷺ and because they were so few compared to the horsed enemy, the Muslims appeared to be like wet sheep on a cold night.
It was then that people said to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA), "These men (forming the army of Hadhrat Usaama (RA)) are the most distinguished of the Muslims and as you see, the Arabs are refusing to follow you. It is therefore not the appropriate time to split up the ranks of the Muslims (by dispatching the army). Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) responded by saying, "I swear by the Being Who controls the life of Abu Bakr! I shall ensure that the army of Usaama is sent according to the instruction of Rasulullaah ﷺ even though I know that wild animals will (attack me as I remain all alone in Madinah and) steal away my body. I shall dispatch the army even though there is none left in any of the towns besides myself." [^2]

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) says, "After Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away, all the Arab tribes renounced Islaam and hypocrisy reared its ugly head. By Allaah! Such conditions faced my father (Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)) that would crush a mighty mountain. The Sahabah (RA) of Rasulullaah ﷺ appeared to be wet sheep on a rainy night in a forest infested with wild animals. By Allaah! Whenever the Sahabah (RA) disputed any matter, my father would eliminate its harm, take control of the reins and pass decisive judgement." [^3]

Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) says, "I swear by the Being besides Whom none other is worthy of worship that none would have been worshipping Allaah had Abu Bakr (RA) not been appointed as Khalifah." He then repeated this a second and a third time. When someone bade him to stop repeating himself, Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) added, "Rasulullaah ﷺ dispatched an army of seven hundred[^4] under the command of Usaama bin Zaid (RA). However, when they had just reached Dhi Khushub when Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away and the Arab tribes around Madinah renounced Islaam.
